messages:
Jordan: Heads up — we’re GA’ing the Hosted OpenAPI Unified Routes tomorrow at 09:00 PT. This unifies streaming + tool-calling + function-calls under a single /v1/unified endpoint and comes with OpenAPI-compatible specs. Docs and migration notes are live: https://docs.redwood.ai/unified-routes :tada:
Maya: Nice! Any breaking changes for customers currently on /v1/stream or /v1/toolcall?
Jordan: No hard breaks. Old endpoints will be supported for 90 days with auto-redirects. We recommend migrating to /v1/unified to take advantage of smarter routing and latency gains. See the migration checklist in the docs.
Aisha: Quick question — does auth or quota model change?
Jordan: Auth stays the same (bearer tokens + scopes). Quotas are enforced per-route but we’ll preserve per-customer quotas when you flip to unified. If you use reserved capacity (Dedicated) talk to your AM for pinning behavior.
Maya: Are there perf differences?
Jordan: On average ~12–18% tail-latency improvement for mixed streaming/tool workloads due to continuous batching + smarter kernel selection. We included benchmark snippets in the notes.
DevRel-Bot: Office hours with Engineering tomorrow 11:00 PT — link: https://meet.redwood.ai/unified-routes-qna :calendar:
Jordan: Rollout plan: canary 09:00–11:00 PT (10% of requests), regional ramp 11:00–15:00 PT, global 15:00–18:00 PT. Ops will watch latency, error-rate, and token-cost metrics.
deploy-bot: prod deployment started: service/unified-routes v1.0.0 -> prod-us-east1
Aisha: Any known regressions to watch for?
Jordan: Known: rare 502s on extremely long-lived multiplexed streams observed in internal canaries — mitigation toggled (prefix-KV caching conservative) until 11:30 PT. If you see client disconnects, fall back to /v1/stream (old) — we’ll auto-scale caches.
Maya: Will there be a deprecation announcement for /v1/toolcall?
Jordan: Yes — we’ll send a customer-facing deprecation 30d before final shutdown. Internal policy: 90d support window post-GA for legacy endpoints.
Aisha: Thank you — posting migration snippets to Customer Success channel now.
Jordan: Thanks all. If you’re on-call tomorrow please keep the #eng-oncall feed open; paging rules unchanged. :phone:
